A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same GenARM research work, with readable text, equations, figures, tables and Appendices A–C. Pages 3–21 have identical extracted text and rendered appearance; the differences on pages 1–2 are fully identifiable.

before.justification: v2 reports original preference-alignment, weak-to-strong guidance and multi-objective experiments in Section 6, plus training-cost measurements and additional comparisons in Appendix C.

after.justification: v4 retains the same original experimental results in Section 6 and Appendix C, including alignment evaluations, inference timings and training-cost measurements.

M1.justification: The autoregressive reward parameterization, training objective, next-token sampling procedure and multi-objective extension in Section 4 are identical. No algorithm or model component changes.

E1.justification: Both versions use HH-RLHF, UltraFeedback, AlpacaEval 2 and PKU-SafeRLHF-10K for the same general preference alignment, weak-to-strong guidance and multi-objective tasks.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged: ARGS, CARDS, Transfer-Q and DPO in Section 6.1; base models, ARGS, Best-of-N and DPO in Section 6.2; Rewarded Soups and MORL in Section 6.3. Appendix comparisons are also identical.

E3.justification: Section 6 and Appendix C retain identical training settings, model scales, decoding controls and evaluation procedures, including the 300-, 805- and 500-prompt evaluations and their respective metrics.

E4.justification: The token-level reward visualization in Figure 3, qualitative multi-objective example in Figure 5 and training-cost analysis in Appendix C.1 are unchanged. No ablation, robustness test or supplementary analysis is added or removed.

E5.justification: Table 1 retains identical plus/minus uncertainty reporting. Neither the main text nor appendices add, remove or revise run-count, seed, confidence-interval or significance-testing information.

E6.justification: All numerical and qualitative results are retained. For example, Table 1 reports the same 51.44 ± 0.35% win-plus-half-tie rate for GenARM against DPO, and Table 2 retains its 7.28-second inference time. Appendix results are identical.

T1.justification: Section 5 retains Definition 1, Lemma 2 and Theorem 3 unchanged. Appendix B retains the same expressiveness and uniqueness results, Corollary 5, proofs and mathematical interpretations.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about reward-model expressiveness, alignment effectiveness and efficiency, weak-to-strong guidance and multi-objective flexibility. The added project-page sentence makes no new scientific claim.

C2.justification: The mechanism interpretations in Appendix B.2, baseline-performance explanations in Section 6 and Appendix C.3, and Section 7's limitation concerning extension to math and coding tasks are unchanged.

D1.justification: v4 adds a project-page URL at the end of the abstract, providing an additional resource-access pointer. Implementation details, hyperparameters, hardware and existing resource links are unchanged. The PDFs do not establish whether code or data were newly released.

R1.justification: Section 2, Appendix A, the bibliography and comparisons with prior research are identical. No cited work or novelty positioning is added, removed or revised.

P1.justification: v4 adds Capital One as an affiliation for Furong Huang and a project-page sentence to the abstract, and updates the arXiv version/date stamp. The scientific prose and section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The expanded affiliation line and added abstract sentence cause small layout changes on pages 1–2, including moving one introduction line onto page 2. All figures, tables and captions are unchanged; pages 3–21 render identically.

improvement.justification: The project-page pointer adds a small navigation convenience, while the affiliation update and local reflow are administrative changes. Methods, proofs, empirical evidence, interpretations and appendices remain identical. These edits do not establish a meaningful net change in overall paper quality.
